findings.finding: No equity supply can be priced inside the window: the company raised $75.6m net in the 2026-08-12 IPO and states the proceeds fund operations through 2028, it has never filed at-the-market language, it has no shelf, and as a company public for under 12 months it is not S-3 eligible, so the commonest second shoe for a falling small-cap biotech (an overnight ATM draw or shelf takedown) is unavailable on 2026-10-06.
findings.mechanism_in_window: An absence that holds for the whole window: the only financing routes require a new S-1 or a resale registration, neither of which is on file (EDGAR submissions show no S-1/S-3/424B filed after 2026-08-12), so nothing can price between the 2026-10-05 close and the 2026-10-06 close.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No financing has occurred since the IPO; the 9 comparable falls since 2026-09-09 (median next close -6.07%) all happened without any supply event, so absence of supply has not stopped continuation on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: The day's ranking is against other fallers, many of which carry live ATMs; the base-rate drift the price embeds assumes the usual cluster of follow-on bad news, part of which (dilution) cannot arrive here. If the price held it, there would be no difference from an ATM-carrying peer - it is a modest, relative positive, not a reason for a bounce.
